description: Silences the TV while the Hub's satellite is listening, follow-up windows included, and puts the volume back when the conversation is over, so TV dialogue never ends up in a transcript. A quarter volume wasn't enough: YouTube's "Thanks for watching!" still got heard and answered. The level before muting is kept in a file on the TV, so a second listen in the same conversation doesn't mute twice, and if the volume got changed in between ("turn the TV up") it's left alone instead of being put back.

data.command: f=/data/local/tmp/hub_duck; if [ ! -f $f ] && dumpsys power | grep -q mWakefulness=Awake; then v=$(dumpsys audio | grep -A5 '^- STREAM_MUSIC' | grep -o 'streamVolume:[0-9]*' | cut -d: -f2); d=0; echo "$v $d" > $f; cmd media_session volume --stream 3 --set $d >/dev/null 2>&1; fi

f=/data/local/tmp/hub_duck; if [ -f $f ]; then read v d < $f; rm -f $f; now=$(dumpsys audio | grep -A5 '^- STREAM_MUSIC' | grep -o 'streamVolume:[0-9]*' | cut -d: -f2); [ "$now" = "$d" ] && cmd media_session volume --stream 3 --set $v >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
